seo.title: Chinese Culture Tools: Names, Menus, Zodiac & Characters
seo.lead: Explore Chinese character senses in teaching name pairs, dish names, lunar-year symbols and short tattoo text, then continue with dictionary pages and local practice.

seo.title: Chinese Name Explorer: 30 Character Teaching Pairs
seo.lead: Explore 30 teaching pairs by style, first character or pinyin. Each character links to its published dictionary sense; these examples are not transliterations or personal naming recommendations.

seo.title: Chinese Menu Decoder: 50 Character-Based Examples
seo.lead: Look up 50 Chinese menu teaching sequences and their character senses. Unknown text stays uncertain; results do not confirm ingredients, allergies or food safety.

seo.title: Chinese Zodiac Calculator: Lunar Year & Stem Element
seo.lead: Find the lunar-year animal and year-stem element for dates from 5 February 2000 through 18 February 2034 using Hong Kong Observatory New Year boundaries. This is not a fate or personality reading.

seo.title: Chinese Tattoo Character Checker: Readings & Context
seo.lead: Check one to eight Chinese characters for published senses, alternative forms and multiple readings. Individual character meanings do not establish the meaning of a whole phrase.

seo.title: Private Teacher Character Decks: Local Practice & Printing
seo.lead: Build private decks of 2 to 100 published Chinese characters, edit their order, practise saved revisions, and print A4 or Letter cards. Decks stay in this browser without an account or cloud sync.
